en.title: Mozart: String Quartet No.19, K.465 – II. Andante cantabile
en.overview: This is a slow, singing movement in 3/4 time. It is one long section of 114 measures that starts and ends in F major. Keys and chords here are estimated by computer, so treat them as a guide. Listen for the first violin's opening tune, for keys that brighten or darken the mood, and for the very soft passages led by the cello.

listening_points.headline: The first violin opens the movement
listening_points.text: The first violin leads from the very first measure [m. 1-3]. It begins softly [m. 1]. The score then marks a sudden loud level (f) at [m. 2]. The home key is F major.

listening_points.headline: Soft and loud flicker within F major
listening_points.text: The music mostly stays soft here. Crescendo markings (gradual getting louder) appear at [m. 4], [m. 8] and [m. 9]. These crescendos lead to a loud level at [m. 10]. It drops suddenly back to soft at [m. 11]. The first violin probably leads, though the lead is not very clear.

listening_points.headline: A move to C major
listening_points.text: The key changes to C major at [m. 14]. The texture is a melody with accompaniment. The first violin probably leads, but the lead is shared for a time.

listening_points.headline: G major, then a loud moment
listening_points.text: The key moves to G major at [m. 21]. A crescendo marked in [m. 20-21] leads to a loud level at [m. 22]. The first violin then clearly takes the tune at [m. 23-25], softly. The others accompany it.

listening_points.headline: Very soft cello, back in C major
listening_points.text: The cello plays alone in [m. 26] at a very soft level. The key returns to C major. The other parts then join with their own lines [m. 27-29]. A crescendo marking appears at [m. 30].

listening_points.headline: F major with block-like chords
listening_points.text: The key goes back to F major at [m. 31]. A loud chord is followed by a soft one at [m. 32]. The parts move together in chords, which is a homophonic texture.

listening_points.headline: Back to C major, lines weave together
listening_points.text: The key is C major again from [m. 35]. The texture is melody with accompaniment at first [m. 35-38]. Then the parts take more independent lines [m. 39-41], with a crescendo marking at [m. 40].

listening_points.headline: The home key returns with loud and soft contrasts
listening_points.text: F major returns at [m. 42]. Loud and soft alternate sharply at [m. 43-48]. A loud level appears at [m. 43] and soft at [m. 44]. Another loud level comes at [m. 46].

listening_points.headline: The loudest point (a computer estimate)
listening_points.text: A computer estimate marks [m. 57] as the loudest and busiest point. It is loud and homophonic, meaning the parts move together. The music drops back to soft at [m. 58].

listening_points.headline: A darker turn to D minor
listening_points.text: The key shifts to D minor at [m. 60]. It starts with a loud chord, then goes soft at [m. 61]. A crescendo marking appears at [m. 64].

listening_points.headline: C major again, led by the first violin
listening_points.text: The key moves to C major at [m. 66]. A loud level appears at [m. 67]. The first violin clearly takes the tune at [m. 72-74], softly, with the others accompanying.

listening_points.headline: The cello alone, very soft, in F major
listening_points.text: F major returns at [m. 75]. The cello plays alone at a very soft level. The other parts join with their own lines from [m. 76].

listening_points.headline: Swells, a loud burst, and the cello in front
listening_points.text: A crescendo marking at [m. 79] leads to a loud level at [m. 80]. Then it is soft again. At [m. 83] there is an fp marking, a loud hit that quickly turns soft. The cello leads from [m. 85], very softly at first. From [m. 90] to [m. 93] it is loud.

listening_points.headline: Soft first violin, then interwoven lines
listening_points.text: The first violin leads softly from [m. 94]. An sf accent (a sudden strong note) is marked at [m. 95]. A loud level appears at [m. 97]. From [m. 101] to [m. 110] the parts play independent lines. It stays mostly soft, with a crescendo marked at [m. 107].

listening_points.headline: A hushed ending in F major
listening_points.text: The music settles into F major and a very soft level at [m. 113]. The cello leads there. The final measure is homophonic, with the parts moving together as chords [m. 114].

glossary.explanation: A marking to get gradually louder.
All parts move together in chords, with the tune on top.
Each instrument plays its own line at the same time.
One part has the tune and the others support it.
The home note and scale that the music feels built around.
A change from one key to another.

zh.title: 莫扎特 C大调弦乐四重奏 K.465 第二乐章：如歌的行板
zh.overview: 这是一个3/4拍的乐章，共114小节，只有一个大段落。主调是F大调，中间会转到C大调、G大调和D小调。请留意第一小提琴在开头的旋律，以及本乐章如何一次次回到F大调。和声由电脑自动估计，调性与和弦可能有误。

listening_points.headline: 第一小提琴在开头领奏
listening_points.text: 本乐章在弱（p）的力度中开始。开头的旋律由第一小提琴领奏 [m. 1-3]。第2小节标为强（f），并带有渐强记号，所以对比很明显。

listening_points.headline: 轻声推进，各声部各唱各的
listening_points.text: 力度回到弱（p） [m. 4-9]。第4至5小节各声部线条相对独立。第8至9小节有渐强记号，声音逐渐变响。

listening_points.headline: 转入C大调
listening_points.text: 音乐转到C大调 [m. 14-20]。第一小提琴大概仍是主角，其余声部伴奏。自动估计的调性可能有误。

listening_points.headline: 短暂到达G大调
listening_points.text: 音乐来到G大调 [m. 21-25]。第20至21小节有渐强记号，第22小节到达强（f），第23小节又突然回到弱（p）。第23至25小节第一小提琴明显领唱。

listening_points.headline: 大提琴在很弱的力度中开口
listening_points.text: 回到C大调，力度降到很弱（pp） [m. 26-30]。第26小节是大提琴独奏。之后大提琴大概仍是主要声部，第30小节有渐强记号。

listening_points.headline: 回到F大调，和声齐整
listening_points.text: 第31小节突然转强（f），回到F大调。随后第32小节转弱（p）。这几小节是主调织体，各声部节奏相近，听起来像一组和弦 [m. 31-34]。

listening_points.headline: 再次转向C大调
listening_points.text: 调性又转到C大调 [m. 35-41]。第一小提琴大概领唱，其他声部伴奏。第39至41小节各声部线条更独立，第40小节有渐强记号。

listening_points.headline: 再回F大调，强弱交替
listening_points.text: 音乐回到F大调 [m. 42-48]。第43小节突然转强（f），第44小节又转弱（p）。第46小节再次转强，并带有渐强记号。

listening_points.headline: 本乐章估计最响的地方
listening_points.text: 第52和53小节有渐强记号，第54小节到强，随后又转弱。第57小节再次突然变强（f）。电脑分析估计这里是本乐章最响、最忙的地方，各声部同步进行。

listening_points.headline: 进入D小调，色调变暗
listening_points.text: 第60小节出现D小调，小调通常听起来更暗 [m. 60-65]。开头是强（f），随后转弱（p）。第一小提琴大概领唱，第64小节有渐强记号。

listening_points.headline: 回到C大调
listening_points.text: 音乐回到C大调 [m. 66-74]。第67小节突然转强（f）。第69至70小节渐强，第71小节又到强（f）。其他处大多为弱。第72至74小节第一小提琴明显领唱。

listening_points.headline: F大调回来，大提琴独奏开场
listening_points.text: 第75小节回到F大调，力度很弱（pp），是大提琴独奏。接下来大提琴大概仍是主要声部 [m. 75-78]。

listening_points.headline: 大提琴领唱，力度渐强到强
listening_points.text: 大提琴大概是主要声部 [m. 85-93]。第85小节很弱（pp），第86小节是三个声部的织体。第89小节有渐强记号，第90至93小节转为强（f）。

listening_points.headline: 第一小提琴回到前台，线条交织
listening_points.text: 第一小提琴大概重新领唱 [m. 94-110]。第94小节转弱（p），第97小节突然转强（f）。第101至110小节各声部线条相对独立，第107小节有渐强记号。

listening_points.headline: 在F大调中很弱地收束
listening_points.text: 本乐章最后停留在F大调 [m. 111-114]。第113小节转为很弱（pp），大提琴领先。第114小节各声部同步，乐章结束。

glossary.explanation: 音乐的中心音和色彩。大调通常较明亮，小调较暗。本指南中的调性是电脑估计的。
音乐的中心从一个调换到另一个调，听起来像换了一个“家”。
声音逐渐变响。只有乐谱上有渐强记号时才这样说。
各声部节奏相近，听起来像一串和弦。
f表示强，p表示弱，pp表示很弱。
